exposure: Women with axSpA treated with NSAIDs
Women with axSpA treated with NSAIDs in combination with conventional synthetic DMARDs, steroids, or analgesics
Women with axSpA treated with biological DMARDs
cohort: 1021 pregnant women with axSpA and 10,210 age-matched and calendar year-matched pregnant controls without axSpA
finding: Women with axSpA had significantly increased odds of caesarean section compared with matched controls.
mod_finding: Compared with controls, women with axSpA showed higher odds of elective caesarean section (aOR 1.52; 1.25 to 1.85).
